description: "An exploration of penguin body mass across species using R."
---

## Data

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

## Load the data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins |> head()
```

## Average body mass by species

```{r}
penguins |>
  drop_na(species, body_mass_g) |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    mean_body_mass = mean(body_mass_g),
    n = n()
  )
```

Gentoo penguins have the largest average body mass among the three species in this dataset.

## Body mass distribution by species

```{r}
#| label: fig-body-mass-species
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of body mass for each penguin species."

penguins |>
  drop_na(species, body_mass_g) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Body mass (g)",
    title = "Penguin Body Mass by Species"
  )
```

The boxplot shows that Gentoo penguins generally have a higher body mass than Adelie and Chinstrap penguins.
